blocks.text: Robi Domingo and his wife, Maiqui Pineda, had their son, Emmanuel, baptized in a ceremony attended by some of their celebrity friends. Darren Espanto and Bianca Gonzalez gave glimpses of the christening through their Instagram Stories on Sunday, Sept. 20. Domingo later reposted their posts on his own Instagram Story.
